book.name: Saame
book.title: KO E TOHI ʻOE NGAAHI SAAME

content.text: Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi kia Sihova he ʻoku angalelei ia:
koeʻuhi ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻoe ngaahi ʻotua:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻEiki ʻoe ngaahi ʻeiki:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia ʻaia tokotaha pe ʻoku fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa fakaofo lahi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe ngaohi ʻi he poto ʻae ngaahi langi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe folahi ʻa māmani ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he ngaahi vai:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe ngaohi ʻae ngaahi maama lahi he ʻoku tolonga,
ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
Ko e laʻā ke pule ʻi he ʻaho:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
Ko e māhina mo e ngaahi fetuʻu ke pule ʻi he pō:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe taaʻi ʻa ʻIsipite ʻi heʻenau ʻuluaki fānau:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
Mo ne ʻomi ʻa ʻIsileli meiate kinautolu:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
‌ʻAki ʻae nima mālohi, mo e nima kuo mafao atu:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia naʻe vaheʻi ke vaeua ʻae Tahi Kulokula:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
Pea ne pule ke ʻalu ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi hono vahaʻa:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
Ka naʻe tulaki ʻa Felo mo ʻene kautau ʻi he Tahi Kulokula:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe tataki hono kakai ʻi he toafa:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Kiate ia ʻaia naʻe taaʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi lahi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Pea tāmateʻi ʻae ngaahi tuʻi naʻe ongoongo:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
Ko Sihoni ko e tuʻi ʻoe kau ʻAmoli:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
Mo Oki ko e tuʻi ʻo Pesani:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa
Pea ne foaki honau fonua ko e tofiʻa:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
Ko e tofiʻa kia ʻIsileli ko ʻene tamaioʻeiki:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
‌ʻAia naʻe manatu kiate kitautolu ʻi heʻetau masiva:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa:
Pea ne huhuʻi ʻakitautolu mei hotau ngaahi fili:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
‌ʻOku ne foaki ʻae meʻakai ki he kakano kotoa pē:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
Mou ʻatu ʻae fakafetaʻi ki he ʻOtua ʻoe langi:
he ʻoku tolonga ʻo taʻengata ʻa ʻene ʻaloʻofa.
